title: Assistant Accountant
description:
Assistant Accountant

£35,000 - £40,000 + Bonus + Excellent Benefits Hybrid Working Flexible Hours

The Opportunity

A fantastic opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Accountant to join a successful international organisation experiencing continued growth.

This role will suit a finance professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and is looking to develop their accounting, reconciliation and analytical skills within a large, multi-entity business.

Working as part of an established finance team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accurate processing, reconciliation and reporting of financial transactions whilst supporting month-end activities and continuous improvement initiatives across the department.

Benefits
- Private healthcare
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Flexible working hours
- Hybrid working arrangement
- 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Life assurance
- Health and wellbeing support programme
- Genuine career development opportunities
- Supportive and collaborative working environment

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and matching supplier invoices.
- Investigating and resolving invoice discrepancies.
- Ensuring costs are accurately coded and allocated.
- Performing balance sheet reconciliations.
- Reviewing and analysing financial transactions.
- Supporting month-end reporting and close processes.
- Assisting with accruals and prepayments.
- Maintaining strong financial controls and accurate records.
- Liaising with suppliers and internal stakeholders to resolve queries.
- Supporting internal and external audit requirements.
- Identifying opportunities to improve processes and efficiencies.

Requirements
- Previous experience within an Assistant Accountant or Finance role.
- AAT Level 4 qualified, part-qualified ACCA/CIMA, or equivalent experience.
- Strong reconciliation experience.
- Advanced Excel skills.
- Experience working within a high-volume finance environment.
- Knowledge of accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
- A proactive approach and willingness to improve processes.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to build relationships across the business.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a leading organisation, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
As an Assistant Accountant in Warrington, you'll play a vital role in supporting the finance team with balance sheets, general ledger accounting and supporting with cost allocation within the P&L on a 12 months fixed term contract.

Client Details

An established and growing international logistics business is seeking an Assistant Accountant to join its finance team on a 12-month fixed-term contract in Warrington. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious finance professional looking to develop their accounting career within a highly experienced team of qualified accountants.Working closely with senior finance stakeholders, you will play a key role in maintaining financial controls, improving processes.

Description

The Assistant Accountant duties include:
- Performing balance sheet reconciliations and investigating outstanding items.
- Reviewing and allocating high volumes of transactions accurately within the general ledger.
- Assisting with month-end close activities and supporting financial reporting requirements.
- Analysing aged balances and ensuring historic transactions are correctly accounted for.
- Supporting the improvement of finance processes, controls and reporting.
- Working closely with operational and finance stakeholders to resolve queries and drive efficiencies.
- Identifying opportunities to automate and improve existing processes through systems and reporting tools.
- VAT treatment
- Preparing analysis using large data sets to support business decision-making.

Profile

A successful Assistant Accountant should have:
- AAT Level 4 studier/qualified or actively studying CIMA/ACCA.
- Good understanding of general ledger accounting and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Understanding of VAT
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP and working with large data sets.
- ERP system knowledge
- Logistics experience desirable, not essential at all.
- Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving ability.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Job Offer

The benefits include:
- Salary ranging from £32,000 to £40,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Fixed-term contract with clear responsibilities in a supportive team.
- Hybrid working (3 days office/2 home)
- Pension
- Flexi-working
- 25 + 8 bank holidays
- Salary sacrifice scheme

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant (Temporary)

Location: Warrington (Hybrid Working)

Salary: £13.50 per hour (depending on experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:00pm (40 hours per week)

Contract: Temporary, up to 6 months initially

We are recruiting for an experienced and proactive Finance Assistant to join a growing organisation based in Warrington. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of their workload, and has a strong background in transactional finance.

This position will initially be offered on a temporary basis for up to six months. However, due to ongoing growth within the business, there may be opportunities for a permanent role in the future.

The Role

Working as part of a busy finance team, you will support the day-to-day financial operations of the business, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and efficiently while maintaining strong financial controls.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Bank reconciliations
- Treasury administration and cash management support
- Payment processing
- Purchase ledger management
- Credit card reconciliations
- Processing and managing employee expenses
- Assisting with account reconciliations
- Supporting month-end finance activities
- Assisting with audit requirements when required
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation

About You

We are looking for a confident and capable finance professional who can hit the ground running and work effectively in a busy environment.

You will have:
- Previous experience in a Finance Assistant, Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Strong experience of bank reconciliations
- Treasury and payment processing experience
- Purchase ledger experience
- Employee expenses processing experience
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Good Excel skills
- A proactive and organised approach to work
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
- Strong communication skills and a positive, team-focused attitude

What's on Offer?
- Competitive hourly rate of £13.50 per hour depending on experience
- Hybrid working with 2 days per week in the Warrington office
- Early exposure to a growing and successful business
- Supportive team environment
- Potential for permanent opportunities following the temporary assignment

If you are an experienced finance professional looking for your next opportunity and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where you can make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you.

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.

company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description:

Job Title: Accounts Assistant / Purchase Ledger Clerk

Location: Warrington

Working Hours: Monday - Thursday, 8:30am - 5:00pm & Friday, 8:30am - 3:00pm

About the Role We have an excellent opportunity for a reliable and organised finance professional to join a busy, friendly head office team in Warrington. In this role, you will provide crucial support to the existing accounts team, taking ownership of day-to-day transactional tasks.

This is a fantastic environment for someone who enjoys a steady, reasonable volume of processing and wants to work within a close-knit, welcoming office. The accounts and office team works collaboratively with the wider admin and customer care departments, making a positive personality and strong team fit just as important as your technical experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes accurately and efficiently.
- Processing and checking receipts.
- General purchase ledger and accounts administration.
- Matching invoices with supporting documentation.
- Ensuring all financial records and transactions are kept fully up to date.
- Assisting with general finance and admin tasks as required to support the wider team.

About You:
- You are organised, reliable, and comfortable processing a reasonable volume of transactions with a high degree of accuracy.
- You can hit the ground running and take pressure off the team with minimal hand-holding.
- Previous experience using Xero is highly advantageous, though not essential if you are comfortable with IT and pick up new accounts systems quickly.
- You are a team player who will naturally slot into a vibrant, friendly office environment.

What's on Offer: Along with joining a welcoming team, you will benefit from excellent working hours, including a 3:00pm finish every Friday to start your weekend early.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Portfolio Payroll is recruiting on behalf of a fantastic accountancy practice for an experienced Payroll Bureau Assistant to join their friendly and supportive team.

This is a great opportunity for someone with payroll experience who enjoys working across multiple clients and payrolls and is looking to develop their career within a busy payroll bureau environment.

The Role
You'll support the wider payroll team with the accurate and timely processing of a variety of payrolls, including:

Weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls
Processing starters, leavers, salary changes, overtime, bonuses and deductions
Supporting RTI submissions and payroll reporting
Assisting with pension auto-enrolment and reconciliations
Producing payslips, reports and payroll summaries
Handling payroll queries from clients and employees
Maintaining accurate and confidential payroll records
Supporting year-end processes, including P60s
Liaising with HMRC, pension providers and clients
Providing general support across the payroll bureau

About You
Numerically strong with excellent attention to detail
Comfortable managing multiple payroll deadlines
Confident using Excel and payroll software
Experienced with systems such as Sage, Superpay or similar
Professional with excellent client/customer service skills
Organised, methodical and proactive
Keen to learn and build a long-term career in payroll

What's on Offer?

Salary up to £33,000
23 days holidays plus bank holidays

Free onsite parking

Ongoing training and development

Supportive and friendly team environment

If this sounds like your next best opportunity, apply directly or call on and ask for Lidya to discuss the role further.
